== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Ultimate Conflict (Virtual Block 7)|Ultimate Conflict]], release 7.3 of [[Virtual Block 7]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of June 3, 2011". The file was created on 25 July 2011.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf VirtualBlock7_3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020184809/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/3d/Set-VB7.3-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
